clips.title: The story
paras: In Redridge, Verner Osgood sends a written requisition west to Smith Argus in Goldshire. It describes Lakeshire’s iron shortage and asks the Elwynn smith for horseshoes.

Lakeshire’s defense has consumed nearly all of Verner Osgood’s iron. The town’s blacksmith has used his reserves to arm and armor the Stormwind Guard, who are stretched thin against invading gnolls and local perils. Meanwhile, Lakeshire’s stables have fallen into neglect, without even basic horseshoes for their mounts. Verner asks Smith Argus in Goldshire to send prepared shoes from Elwynn, so the town can shoe its horses.
